observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A spacious dance studio with a light wooden floor, mirrors lining the walls, and gym equipment visible in the background.
observation.dancers: A group of women dancing together, led by an instructor at the front.
observation.formation_and_space: Dancers arranged in rows facing the front mirror, stepping in place and moving side-to-side.
observation.posture: Upright torso with soft knees and continuous weight shifts between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping in place, marching knees up, and stepping side to side matching the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms alternate between pumping by the sides, pushing forward, and raising overhead in sweeping motions.
observation.hips_and_torso: Natural hip movement and torso twisting accompanying the directional steps.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to moderate level changes with knee lifts and quick turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Athletic fitness attire including sleeveless tops and leggings, sneakers.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement on fast steps due to rapid motion and camera angles.

signature_moments.what: Stepping wide to the side while sweeping arms horizontally and alternating overhead reaches.
Stretching arms wide to the sides while stepping side to side.
